_comment: SAMPLE invite. The groom, host, date, time and venue below are placeholders for a demo, not a real event.
landingLine: The Best Man is sending you an invite. Pass the level to find out what it is!
landingSubline: Fair warning: this level fights back.
howToPlay: You see the hotel through Dave's eyes. Your left thumb walks him around. Drag on the right side to look, and hold the THROW button to fling sausages, with a little auto-aim to help. On a computer, use WASD to move, the mouse to look and click to throw.
Escorts pour out of the hotel rooms and try to catch the groom. It takes a few sausage hits to shoo each one away. The purple ones grab on and drain your health, so hit them fast.

Beers on the floor top up your health. A blue pill makes your sausages SUPER firm for exactly 5 seconds, shown by the countdown ring. They come out bigger, stiffer and glowing, do triple damage and go straight through.
You carry 10 sausages before you reload. Reach the elevator at the end of Floor 7, but the Diva guards it. Shoo her to open the doors.
location: The Grand Hotel, Floor 7, Toronto (sample venue)
extraNote: Dress code: antlers encouraged. What happens on Floor 7 stays on Floor 7.
privacyNote: No ads. No tracking. The only information collected is what you type in the RSVP, if you choose to send it.
